program:
(rule!
 ;; The top row is a LEGEND (later colors outrank earlier). Below it,
 ;; edge emitters shoot rays straight into the field, stopping at
 ;; gray(5) blockers. Where rays cross, the highest-ranked color wins.
 ;; Output: blockers + emitters + rays (rays never overwrite either).
 (lambda (g)
   (let ()
     (define legend (filter (lambda (v) (not (= v 0))) (first g)))
     (define field (subgrid g 1 0 (- h 1) (- w 1)))
     (define fh (rows field))
     (define fw (cols field))
     (define blockers (find-color field 5))
     (define (rank color)
       (let loop ((xs legend) (i 0))
         (cond ((empty? xs) -1)
               ((= (first xs) color) i)
               (else (loop (rest xs) (+ i 1))))))
     (define (emitters-at cells dr dc)
       (filter (lambda (x) x)
               (map (lambda (p)
                      (let ((v (at field (first p) (second p))))
                        (and (not (member? v (list 0 5)))
                             (list (first p) (second p) v dr dc))))
                    cells)))
     (define emitters
       (append (emitters-at (map (lambda (c) (list 0 c))
                                 (range 0 fw))
                            1 0)
               (emitters-at (map (lambda (c) (list (- fh 1) c))
                                 (range 0 fw))
                            -1 0)
               (emitters-at (map (lambda (r) (list r 0))
                                 (range 1 (- fh 1)))
                            0 1)
               (emitters-at (map (lambda (r) (list r (- fw 1)))
                                 (range 1 (- fh 1)))
                            0 -1)))
     (define (ray e)  ;; cells the emitter's beam covers
       (let loop ((r (+ (first e) (fourth e)))
                  (c (+ (second e) (nth e 4)))
                  (acc (list)))
         (cond ((not (in-bounds? r c fh fw)) (reverse acc))
               ((member? (list r c) blockers) (reverse acc))
               (else (loop (+ r (fourth e)) (+ c (nth e 4))
                           (cons (list r c) acc))))))
     (define proposals  ;; (r c color) per beam cell
       (flatmap (lambda (e)
                  (map (lambda (p) (list (first p) (second p)
                                         (third e)))
                       (ray e)))
                emitters))
     (define base
       (for/fold ((out (paint-cells (empty-grid fh fw 0) blockers 5)))
                 ((e (in-list emitters)))
         (set-cell out (first e) (second e) (third e))))
     (for*/fold ((out base)) ((r (in-range fh)) (c (in-range fw)))
       (let ((hits (filter (lambda (p) (and (= (first p) r)
                                            (= (second p) c)))
                           proposals)))
         (if (or (empty? hits) (not (= (at out r c) 0)))
             out
             (set-cell out r c
                       (third (first (sort hits
                                           (lambda (a b)
                                             (> (rank (third a))
                                                (rank (third b))))))))))))))
